services.name: houseboat rental
services.desc: A vintage 36'x12' Thunderbird houseboat moored in a stocked pond delivers waterborne living with a queen bed, galley, head, and raised bridge for unique overnight experiences. Berry Creek Cabins' houseboat 'A Shore Bet' sits permanently on a private pond, so you enjoy the sensation of floating without navigating open water. The vessel includes a sleeping cuddy for extra guests, a galley for meal prep, and a raised bridge where you can sit with morning coffee and watch fish rise. This setup appeals to couples seeking something more adventurous than a traditional cabin, as well as families who want to introduce children to life on the water in a safe, controlled setting.
